title: Territory2SupportedObject - Tooling API
description: Represents the object type supported by territories. This object is available in API version 57.0 and later.

DefaultAccessLevel.description: Default access level for objects assigned to territories.

ObjectType.description: Object type supported by the territory.

State.description: Status of the support activation of the object type.

special_access_rules: Enable the Manage Territories user permission.
wsdl_segment:
```xml
<xsd:complexType name="Territory2SupportedObject">
  <xsd:complexContent>
    <xsd:extension base="ens:sObject">
      <xsd:sequence>
        <xsd:element name="DefaultAccessLevel" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="DurableId" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="ObjectType" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="State" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string" nillable="true"/>
      </xsd:sequence>
    </xsd:extension>
  </xsd:complexContent>
</xsd:complexType>
```
